label: president or manager of
definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified president or manager office in organization, team or institution Y.
scope_notes: Preserves the earlier combined president/manager scope. Explicit historical office qualifies. Generic leader, running/control, director, chairman, founder, owner, coach or athlete leadership alone does not establish either specified office. Manager cases are marked as the deliberately broader role family.

facts.reason: Feldman is explicitly president of United Federation of Teachers; generic leader evidence is not needed.
Young is explicitly manager and president of Giants; the linebacker-question path is unrelated.
Terry is called a leader and runs Operation Rescue, but neither row identifies the chosen president or manager office.
Harazin is explicitly Mets president and manager in several constructions.
Bergsten is explicitly president of Institute for International Economics; running the institute is corroborating but insufficient alone.
